product_metadata.title: Beautyrest Simmons Siesta Rollaway Mattress: Roll-Up Guest/Floor Mat, 3" Twin, White
features: Lightweight lounger instantly provides a comfortable relaxing pad or lounging solution. Set Up: Simply take your mattress out of the box and enjoy watching it decompress. Jumping, walking, and sleeping on your mattress can speed up the process.
Features 3" thick plush Gel foam, which consists of comfort Gel foam, Twin size lounger measures 3" H x 72" L x 30" W.
When not in use, it conveniently rolls up to just 12" in diameter, allowing for a hassle-free transportation and compact storage.
Includes a removable ultra-plush, polyester stretch knit machine-washable cover. Use for reading, lounging, watching TV, dorm rooms, playrooms.

Lounger is compressed and rolled for shipping, so please allow for 72 hours for the foam to fully expand; 3" thickness measurement includes the foam support layers and the quilted fabric cover combined.
description: Simmons Siesta Gel Foam Rollup Lounger is great for relaxing anywhere .Enjoy the combination of both contouring Gel foam and plush comfort foam that provides amazing support for feeling refreshed the next day. The lounger is surrounded by an ultra-plush, quilted cover with air flow technology, that is both removable and washable for a clean, hygienic surface every time. Storage is quick and easy. This light weight, easily transported mat is perfect for relaxing or lounging anywhere.
